name: Noshiro Masaki
source: Masaki was transferred to a new company close to his aunts home. By his mothers request instead of finding a place to stay he is sent to stay at his aunts house to confirm the current relationship between his aunt and uncle and is ordered to intervene if necessary . Due to his mother worrying about her little sister(Masaki aunt). Masaki is somewhat of a pervert.
